definitions.Semantic_Cosine: Raw cosine similarity of sentence/group embeddings; not a probability.
definitions.DP_Score: Centered semantic score after neutral threshold and merge penalty, plus weak lexical hint for 1-1.
definitions.Weak_Lexical_Anchor: Optional Sino-Vietnamese exact n-gram overlap; not a hard constraint and not character-level correction.
definitions.Review_Flag: Heuristic review indicator; not a correctness label.
definitions.OMISSION_ADDITION_MISSING_Label_Target_O: Left blank because they require ground truth or OCR confidence input.
